jobs.title: Digital & Social Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About ARTECHOUSE**
====================

ARTECHOUSE is the nation's first innovative art space dedicated to experiential and technology-driven art. Working at the intersection of art, science, and technology, we create immersive exhibitions in New York, Washington DC, and Houston that redefine how audiences experience art.

**About the role**
------------------

You will own how ARTECHOUSE shows up online and turn that presence into audience and ticket sales growth. You'll set strategy and lead execution across our website, social channels, email, influencer and creator partnerships, and paid media.

Beyond traditional channel management, this role is explicitly focused on architecting, deploying, and managing customized AI agents and automated workflows. Much of your execution capacity will come from a team of AI agents that you design, deploy, and manage, covering content ideation, ad optimization, customer journey automation, and reporting. You'll decide what agents do, connect them to our tools, and review their work so quality stays high and our voice stays human.

**What you'll do**
------------------

### **Core digital marketing strategy and execution**

* 360° digital campaigns: Lead and execute high-performing digital marketing across email, social media, content production, website, paid digital media, and search to grow audiences, ticket sales, and brand awareness.
* Set the strategy for each social platform (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, LinkedIn, and new channels as they emerge).
* Plan content around exhibitions, events, and seasonal moments in each city, and grow engaged local audiences through community management.
* Build and run the influencer and creator program: sourcing, outreach, hosted visits, contracts, FTC disclosure, and performance tracking.

### **Paid media:**

* Plan, build, and run all paid campaigns in house on Meta, Google and AI searches, including budget by location, audiences, creative testing, retargeting, and attribution to ticket sales.
* Set benchmarks, structure campaigns, manage bids and budget pacing, and audit spend efficiency.
* Report on spend, return on ad spend, and cost per ticket.

### **Website, ticketing, and email**

* Own the website and location pages: content, exhibition launches, SEO, UX, and conversion rate optimization with internal and external technical partners.
* Monitor ticketing platform performance, conversion, and promotions so the purchase path stays smooth.
* Direct email and newsletter strategy, keeping brand, visuals, and storytelling consistent across all channels.

### **Planning, collaboration, and leadership**

* Own the master digital marketing calendar for exhibitions, private events, press, and company priorities.
* Partner with marketing and location teams on launches, collateral, and revenue initiatives.
* Supervise and mentor AI agents, junior marketing staff/interns, and freelancers.

### **AI agents and automation**

* Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents and automated workflows for content drafting, scheduling, audience segmentation, asset tagging, lead nurturing, and admin tasks.
* Run agents that pull cross-channel data into regular performance and ROI reports, with forecasts where the data supports them.
* Keep a human in the loop: review agent output before it goes public, and own accuracy, brand voice, and data privacy.
* Document each agent's purpose, inputs, tools, and owner so the system can scale and be handed off.
* Research and pilot new AI tools, and recommend which ones to adopt, scale, or retire.

**Qualifications & Requirements**
---------------------------------

* 4+ years in digital marketing, running multi-channel campaigns across paid, social, email, and SEO/SEM.
* Hands-on experience with Meta Ads and Google Ads, with results tied to sales or bookings, building and optimizing campaigns yourself rather than through an agency.
* Hands-on experience with AI-powered advertising, such as Meta Advantage+ and Google Performance Max campaigns, AI-generated and AI-tested ad creative, and emerging ad placements in AI search and assistants.
* Proven experience creating AI agents yourself, not just using AI tools: designing their instructions, connecting them to data and tools, and putting them into real workflows. Examples include custom GPTs or Claude projects, agent builders, automation tools. Be ready to show work you've built.
* Comfort with GA4, ticketing or e-commerce conversion data, and reporting dashboards.
* Willingness to experiment with new tools, APIs, and integrations.
* Strong organization across complex schedules, exhibition rollouts, and many stakeholders.
* A strong visual and editorial eye, with clear writing.
* A genuine interest in digital art, immersive experiences, and emerging media.

**Nice to have**
----------------

* Experience in arts, culture, attractions, live events, or ticketed experiences.
* Multi-location or multi-market marketing experience.
* Experience supervising staff, interns, or freelancers.
* Short-form video production or editing skills.

**Salary:** 75,000–115,000 per year, commensurate with experience  
  
**This is a Hybrid/Remote role but candidates must be commutable to either NYC or Washington DC.**

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager | GTM Program Operations
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced **Product Marketing Manager with a strong background in Go to Market (GTM) program operations** to support a strategic enterprise partner pilot program within a leading technology organization.

This role focuses on the operational execution of product marketing initiatives, including program tracking, reporting, partner coordination, documentation, and cross functional collaboration.

The ideal candidate brings 4 to 6 years of experience supporting product marketing, GTM operations, or program management teams within a technology or enterprise software environment. Success requires exceptional organization, strong written communication, attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage multiple workstreams and deadlines.

This is an execution focused position supporting established product marketing strategies rather than owning product positioning or strategic direction.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**Program Management & Operational Execution**

* Own and maintain multiple program execution and partner pilot trackers, ensuring accurate milestones, deliverables, ownership, and status updates.
* Coordinate inputs across 10 or more contributors, proactively following up on outstanding deliverables and identifying potential delays.
* Maintain consistent program tracking processes and ensure documentation remains accurate and current.
* Monitor open issues, coordinate resolution with internal stakeholders, and escalate blockers as needed.

**Reporting & Program Communications**

* Develop and distribute recurring biweekly program status reports by consolidating information from multiple systems and stakeholders.
* Translate program updates, milestones, risks, and outstanding action items into clear, actionable summaries.
* Maintain consistent reporting formats and deliver accurate updates within established deadlines.
* Prepare meeting summaries, action items, and follow up documentation.

**Partner Coordination & Meeting Logistics**

* Coordinate partner working sessions, workshops, and multiday program immersions.
* Manage scheduling across multiple time zones, meeting agendas, presentation materials, and session logistics.
* Capture meeting notes, document decisions, and prepare timely post meeting summaries.
* Ensure stakeholders have the information and materials needed for successful program execution.

**Documentation & Marketing Asset Support**

* Create and maintain professional presentations, spreadsheets, program documentation, and enablement materials using established outlines.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, formatting, and version control across program assets.
* Organize documentation and maintain structured internal repositories.
* Support preparation of partner facing materials through established internal review and approval processes.

**Cross Functional Collaboration**

* Work closely with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Legal, and partner facing teams to coordinate deliverables.
* Proactively gather updates, resolve operational questions, and maintain accountability across workstreams.
* Identify execution risks and communicate potential solutions to program leadership.
* Support consistent operational processes across multiple partner initiatives.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* 4 to 6 years of relevant experience in product marketing operations, GTM operations, program management, or a closely related function.
* Experience supporting technology, SaaS, or enterprise software organizations.
* Demonstrated ability to independently manage complex project trackers, milestones, timelines, and multiple contributors.
* Strong experience consolidating information from multiple sources into recurring program status reports.
* Experience coordinating cross functional meetings, workshops, or partner sessions across time zones.
* Proficiency creating professional presentations, spreadsheets, reports, and program documentation.
* Excellent written communication skills, with the ability to independently draft concise and accurate program updates.
* Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to prioritize competing deadlines.
* Proven ability to drive accountability and coordinate stakeholders without direct reporting authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience supporting enterprise partner programs, pilot initiatives, product launches, or partner onboarding.
* Familiarity with business messaging platforms, communications technology, CPaaS, or conversational AI solutions.
* Previous experience supporting Product Marketing or GTM operations within a large technology organization.
* Advanced spreadsheet capabilities, including formulas, pivot tables, dashboards, and automated reporting.
* Experience using AI productivity tools to assist with summarization, documentation, reporting, or data cleanup.
* Familiarity with issue tracking, program governance, and operational reporting processes.

  

**Location**: Remote (United States)

**Role type:** Initial contract assignment through the end of 2026, with potential for extension

**Expected hours**: 40 per week

**Benefits:**

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Vision insurance

**Schedule:**

* 8 hour shift
* Monday to Friday

**Application Question(s):**

* Do you or will you in the future require any sponsorship to work in the US?

**Language:**

* English (Required)

jobs.title: Patient Experience & Marketing Operations Specialist
jobs.description:
**Patient Experience & Marketing Operations Specialist**

*Creative Mind. Analytical Eye. Drive to Make Things Better.*

**Reports To:** Director of Business Operations & Patient Experience  
**Job Type:** Part-Time (20–25 hours/week) with potential to transition to Full-Time  
**Work Arrangement:** Hybrid (Remote & On-site at Clinic Locations)  
  
**Summary:** The Patient Experience & Growth Specialist is responsible for driving patient volume and delivering an exceptional patient journey across Advanced Urgent Care & Occupational Medicine and Platte River Medical Clinic. This hybrid role combines strategic patient communications and marketing with operational data analysis.  
  
By evaluating patient workflows, monitoring key clinic metrics, managing digital channels, and leveraging real-time data, you will identify opportunities to increase patient volume, optimize front-end clinic processes, and maintain a seamless patient experience online and in-clinic.  
  
**Duties and Responsibilities** include the following. Other duties may be assigned.

* Marketing, Patient Communications & Brand Presence
  + Digital & Local Marketing: Maintain clinic website content, CMS updates (WordPress), and local business listings (Google Business Profile) to drive search visibility, accurate service/hours information, and online booking traffic.
  + Patient Messaging & Campaigns: Draft and design patient communications (emails, text announcements, in-clinic signage, FAQs) using Canva/Adobe. Plan and execute compliant bulk SMS campaigns (HIPAA, TCPA).
  + Reputation & Sentiment Management: Monitor and respond to online reviews across platforms in a timely, HIPAA-compliant manner. Track sentiment trends and turn patient feedback into actionable reputation strategies.
  + Outreach & Employer Services: Support marketing initiatives for occupational medicine, employer clients, community partners, and seasonal healthcare programs.

* Workflow Analysis, Operations & Systems
  + Process & Volume Optimization: Analyze front-desk, registration, and patient-flow workflows to identify bottlenecks, eliminate inefficiencies, and implement process changes that boost capacity and intake volume.
  + Systems Support: Troubleshoot and optimize day-to-day scheduling, check-in, and digital registration platforms for staff and patients; identify recurring technical or workflow gaps.
  + Standardization: Help create and refine front-end SOPs, scripts, and staff resources to ensure consistent, high-quality patient interactions across all touch points.

* Data Analysis & Performance Reporting
  + Data Extraction & Insights: Pull, filter, and analyze operational, marketing, and scheduling data, and campaign tools.
  + Performance Tracking: Monitor key performance indicators including patient volume, wait times, registration completion rates, conversion rates, campaign ROI, and revenue trends.
  + Actionable Reporting: Segment performance data by location, provider, and service line to deliver clear recommendations and growth strategies to executive leadership.

**Education/Experience:**

* High school diploma or general education degree (GED); or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5+ years in patient experience, healthcare marketing/communications, or clinical workflow analysis.

**Specialized Training:**

* Data & Analytical Skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel/data filtering to analyze operational metrics, patient volume trends, and financial reports, translating data into tangible process improvements.
* Marketing & Digital Tools: Hands-on experience with CMS platforms (WordPress), graphic design tools (Canva), online listing management, and mass communication platforms (bulk SMS/email).
* Compliance: Strong working knowledge of HIPAA regulations, TCPA SMS consent requirements, and patient privacy standards.
* Adaptability: Self-motivated professional capable of managing multiple cross-functional projects independently in a hybrid environment.

**Preferred**

* Background in Urgent Care, Occupational Medicine, or Primary Care settings.
* Familiarity with online review management platforms and basic local SEO best practices.

**Key Performance Indicators & Growth Goals**

* Increase Overall Patient Volume: Drive online bookings, site traffic conversions, and repeat visits through targeted communication and operational efficiency.
* Elevate Patient Experience: Achieve high online review scores, rapid resolution of patient feedback, and seamless digital check-in adoption.
* Optimize Operational Workflows: Reduce registration errors, streamline patient wait times, and successfully implement data-backed workflow enhancements.

**WHO WE ARE**

Aparium Hotel Group is a leading hotel company founded and led by experienced professionals in hotel development, management, and marketing. We share one defining belief: great hotels should be destinations sought out by travelers and favorite gathering places for locals. We call this philosophy Trans-local Hospitality.

Our passion and expertise center on independent hotels, resorts, and restaurants in distinct cities and unique resort destinations. We believe every property should be a brand in its own right—a true celebration of its independent identity and setting.

**THE OPPORTUNITY**
===================

**We're seeking a strategic, hands-on marketing and communications leader to shape the next chapter of Aparium's growth.**
==========================================================================================================================

As Director of Marketing & Communications, you'll lead integrated marketing, public relations, content, campaigns, and communications across our portfolio of independent hotels and restaurants. You'll guide the guest journey from first impression through lifelong loyalty, ensuring every marketing effort drives awareness, reputation, engagement, and revenue.

This role is ideal for someone who is equally comfortable developing high-level strategy and executing against it. You're a storyteller, relationship builder, brand steward, and marketing operator who thrives in a fast-moving entrepreneurial environment.

Based in our Chicago headquarters, you'll partner closely with hotel leadership, corporate teams, agency partners, and senior executives to elevate our brands and support portfolio performance.

* Establish channel plans, content frameworks, campaign calendars, and performance metrics.
* Define KPIs and measure marketing effectiveness in partnership with revenue and commercial teams.
* Identify opportunities to optimize performance, guest engagement, and brand awareness.

* Oversee content development, creative production, and external creative partnerships.
* Collaborate across teams to execute integrated campaigns that support hotel and restaurant business goals.
* Build and evolve portfolio-wide email marketing, database growth, and audience segmentation strategies.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with travel, hospitality, and lifestyle media.
* Manage agency partners and evaluate performance through measurable outcomes.
* Lead award submission strategies and identify opportunities to increase brand visibility and recognition.
* Support reputation management, media training, and crisis communication preparedness.

### **Support New Openings & Brand Growth**

* Lead go-to-market marketing and communication plans for hotel openings and significant brand initiatives.
* Partner with internal and external stakeholders to manage pre-opening marketing activities.
* Support repositioning and performance improvement initiatives across the portfolio.
* Ensure brand consistency and integrity across all guest touchpoints.

### **Inspire & Develop Teams**

* Lead and mentor field marketing managers and agency partners.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and professional growth.
* Build strong relationships with hotel General Managers and operational leaders across the organization.

---------------------------

### **Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Public Relations, or a related field.
* 7+ years of progressive experience in marketing, communications, and public relations.
* 3+ years of experience leading marketing efforts across multiple hotel properties or markets.
* Experience within luxury, lifestyle, boutique, or independent hospitality brands.
* Restaurant, food & beverage, or lifestyle brand marketing experience is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated success managing agencies, vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

### **Skills & Expertise**

* Strong understanding of integrated marketing, public relations, content strategy, and brand development.
* Established media relationships within travel, lifestyle, and hospitality sectors.
* Experience utilizing marketing analytics and customer data to inform decision-making.
* Familiarity with CRM and email marketing platforms such as Revinate or similar solutions.

* Excellent written, verbal, and presentation abilities.

At Galen College of Nursing, we educate and empower nurses to change lives. Since 1989, we’ve dedicated our work to delivering high-quality nursing education with a student-first mindset. As one of the largest private nursing colleges in the country, we combine the support of a close-knit learning environment with the strength of a nationally recognized institution, HCA Healthcare.

That same passion for excellence in the classroom extends to our offices. At Galen, you’ll find a culture deeply rooted in collaboration, innovation, and a shared commitment to improving the future of healthcare. Your work directly touches the next generation of nurses, and your contributions help our students pursue their dream of a compassionate career.

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a difference, grow professionally, and be part of a caring team, we’d love for you to apply for the *Marketing Associate* position today!

**Click here to learn more about Galen!**

**Position Overview:**

As a Marketing Associate at Galen College of Nursing, you will coordinate and track execution of integrated marketing efforts for the College as a whole and support the Marketing Manager in execution of marketing needs for the individual campuses, including admissions collateral, promotional materials and events. The Marketing Associate will also be responsible for the development of all organic social media content and assist with Environmental Branding/facilities creative execution. The ideal candidate for this position is driven, takes initiative to keep work moving, has an established ability to identify quality in design and copy, and is guided by a need for excellence in communication. The candidate is well-organized and demonstrates efficient project management skills with a desire to share and bring new ideas to the team.

jobs.description:
Overview:

**The Michaels Organization is a national leader in residential real estate offering full-service capabilities in development, property management, construction, and investment. At Michaels, our teammates strive to fulfill our promise of creating communities that lift lives – ones that jumpstart housing, education, civic engagement, and neighborhood prosperity. With this passion at the forefront of our business, Michaels teammates can be proud to be a part of the extraordinary, every day.**

The Marketing Coordinator will be responsible for developing and implementing a marketing and communications plan for the project. This employee will work closely with leasing, management, the partners, outlying communities, media, and other posts to ensure proper marketing and public relations.

Responsibilities:

1. Develop and implement annual marketing plans that will successfully increase occupancy and traffic for the project. This includes executing all branding, collateral, and content to achieve targeted goals for the project.  
2. Develop and track performance metrics and analyses to measure the effectiveness of marketing techniques and leasing incentives/concessions.  
3. Develop all outreach marketing material (brochures, flyers, signs, advertisements, etc.) to implement a branded look for the project.  
4. Conduct market comparison reports monthly to compare the company’s performance and competitiveness.  
5. Serve as spokesperson for the project, promoting a positive relations image to the U.S. Military and outlying communities.  
6. Create partnerships with local businesses and organizations in an effort to strengthen the relationship between the project and the community.  
7. Prepare and present presentations on behalf of the project to update progress.  
8. Attend conferences and seminars, for networking opportunities and exposure to outlying companies.  
9. Design and publish monthly newsletters and event flyers for all individuals connected to the housing project, as well as to Army personnel.
  
10. Manage company website and all social media marketing.  
11. Manage and maintain the marketing budget.  
12. Coordinate and plan all internal and external monthly events.  
13. Manage all event administration, including structure, communication, catering, decoration, and staffing for all resident and employee functions and events.

Qualifications:

**Required Experience:**

1. 1+ years of Marketing Experience, preferably in Property Management.  
2. Knowledge and understanding of the marketing culture and dynamic.  
3. Significant experience working with customers, media, partners and other critical audiences.  
4. Strong understanding of Public Relations principles, practices and processes.  
5. Perform other duties as assigned.  
6. Must be able to pass background investigation and drug test screening.

**Required Education/Training:**

1. High School Diploma or GED.  
2. Valid Driver’s License and acceptable driving record.  
3. Must successfully complete all required courses, classes, and training provided by MMS.

**Required Skills and Abilities:**

1. Must be able to work as part of a team, as well as complete assignments independently.  
2. Ability to work in a self-motivated, fast-paced environment, at all levels of an organization  
3. Perform duties under pressure and meet deadlines in a timely manner.  
4. Must have excellent writing and communication skills.  
5. Must be able to read and write legibly to complete required marketing and leasing reports, as well as traffic and leasing incentive analyses.  
6. Must be available for minimal travel for conferences and outreach opportunities.  
7. Prioritize and manage daily workload to ensure successful completion.  
8. Take instructions from supervisors.  
9. Exercise problem-solving skills.  
10. Interact with co-workers, supervisors, vendors, residents, guests, and the public in a professional and pleasant manner.  
11. Any employee in this position must be knowledgeable and skilled in Microsoft Programs, to include:  
a. Microsoft Publisher  
b. Microsoft Power Point  
c. Microsoft Excel

We're looking for a **Principal Marketing Manager** to own the strategic vision for how Vivint builds retention and engagement across every customer touchpoint. You'll audit the current state of Vivint's marketing experiences across all surfaces, identify where the gaps and opportunities are, and set the strategic direction for what comes next. You'll be the person in the room translating brand insight into customer strategy, and the person leadership turns to when the marketing problem is genuinely hard. jobs.description:
**About Mid Hudson Energy Transition**

Mid-Hudson Energy Transition, Inc. (MHET) is a not-for-profit community-based organization that empowers municipalities, their residents, and businesses to own and share renewable energy, create healthier buildings, and join in community wealth-building to strengthen the resilience of the Hudson Valley in the face of climate change. We engage and build on the active involvement of communities, with particular emphasis on low-income and communities of color that are being harmed first and worst by climate change.

**Job Summary**

The Marketing and Content Manager shapes how MHET looks, sounds, and shows up for community members, funders, partners, and the public. This person owns MHET's brand and the day-to-day work of telling our story: social media, the website, the monthly newsletter, graphic design, event promotion, program recruitment campaigns, and energy education materials that help residents understand their homes, their bills, and their energy choices.

They work closely with program staff to turn real outcomes and real people's stories into materials that are clear, accessible, and true to the communities we serve. They also help our team share what MHET has learned with the wider field – producing the annual impact report, social media videos, presentations, and toolkits that show how a community-rooted model for energy justice actually works. This is a hands-on, high-output role for a strong designer and writer who likes seeing their work out in the world, someone equally comfortable designing a flyer, drafting a newsletter, and planning a campaign calendar.

**Reports To**

* Executive Director

**Our Programs**

**Outreach & Education (O&E):** Outreach is the cornerstone of all that we do. At its core, MHET is a community-based organization, formed in service to the Kingston community and the marginalized people who have been overburdened by environmental hazards here. Through our O&E program, we listen to the community’s needs, connect people to our programs, revise or co-create new programs in partnership with our Community Council, and create inclusive and accessible ways to educate our community on energy systems, solutions, and justice.

**The HELP Fund:** The HELP Fund is the Hudson Valley’s first green community investment fund. It mobilizes local capital to accelerate the transition away from fossil fuels while expanding access to safe, affordable, and energy-efficient housing for low- and moderate-income households. By offering a range of investment opportunities to both accredited and non-accredited investors, the Fund enables community members to invest directly in solutions that strengthen local resilience, reduce energy burden, and build long-term community wealth.

**The Home Energy Loan Program (HELP):** HELP provides 2% interest loans that help residents finance home energy upgrades that boost safety, health, energy efficiency, and climate resilience. Beyond financing, HELP offers wraparound project management support and includes incentives designed to empower borrowers, build wealth, enhance financial literacy, and support recovery from financial setbacks. This program is here to make energy improvements more accessible, impactful, and supportive of long-term financial wellbeing.

**Home Upgrade Grants (HUG):** HUG provides holistic project management to low-income homeowners for home improvements related to health, safety, energy efficiency and electrification. Through wrap-around technical and financing support – including grantmaking – and in collaboration with contractors and government agencies, HUG empowers residents to live in safe, healthy, efficient, and affordable homes, ready for electrification and resilient to climate emergencies.

**Energy Innovation (EI):** Energy Innovation encompasses a portfolio of projects with the central goal of empowering marginalized communities to own and share renewable energy; as such, it includes community solar (discounts on electricity bills through shared solar projects), renewable energy project development, and community energy planning. Currently, the EI team has been exploring a municipal thermal energy network, community-owned solar project, and an agrivoltaics pilot (agricultural farms paired with solar generation). Community ownership models, income generation for frontline communities, and local grid resilience are core considerations.

**Responsibilities**

*Program Materials & Design (30%)*

* Co-develop an annual marketing calendar with program and leadership staff that sets a strategic cadence of campaigns, timed to meet recruitment, outreach, and fundraising goals.
* Design visual assets for MHET's marketing, events, and fundraising – including social graphics, event flyers, presentations, and sponsor recognition materials – using tools such as Canva and Adobe.
* Design and write program materials and energy education resources – workshop slides, handouts, FAQs, explainers, infographics, talking points, and short videos – that help residents understand MHET's programs, energy systems, utility bills, home upgrades, and energy justice, with subject-matter support from program staff.
* Translate technical and policy topics (e.g., heat pumps, weatherization, community solar, thermal energy networks) into plain-language, visually clear materials.
* Ensure all materials are culturally responsive, accessible, and reflective of the communities MHET serves, and advance language justice by making all materials available in plain language and in English and Spanish, in coordination with MHET’s in-house translation support.
* Test materials with community members and the Community Council, and revise based on what people find useful and clear.

*Channel Management (30%)*

* Lead MHET's social media presence across platforms: developing content calendars, creating and scheduling posts, monitoring engagement, and growing audience, including building MHET's video presence

jobs.description:
**Digital Marketing Manager Opportunity at Orange County's Federal Credit Union**

**Local Southern California Candidates Only Please.** ***Our leaders work from the headquarters office in Santa Ana, CA on Tuesdays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. They may choose to work remote on Mondays and Fridays.***

Are you a high-energy, fast moving Marketing **Leader and** Agent of Change? Do you have that “Fire in the Belly” for and are passionate about breaking through and disrupting entire categories with powerful Branding Creative that Engages, Informs, and Motivates huge growth in Awareness, Sales, Revenue, and Industry Leadership? Are you obsessed with creating profitable Lead Generation ***and Sales*** across online and offline channels and love the analytical studies that come with it? Do you see the Vision that others don’t, and have the ability to inspire them to follow you there? Then we want to talk to you.

We are seeking a dynamic and visionary **Digital Marketing Manager** to enhance the credit union’s digital presence, reputation, member experience, and lead generation across all digital channels. In this role you will develop and execute digital communications strategies, manage social media platforms, create compelling email campaigns, and ensuring consistent brand messaging across all digital touchpoints. You’ll report to the VP of Online Marketing and working closely with the SVP Marketing, will be results-driven with expertise in managing brand communications, driving engagement, lead generation, and optimizing digital member experiences.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Digital Strategy and Brand Management

* Oversee and manage the credit union’s digital footprint, ensuring a consistent brand presence across all digital platforms, including website, social media, email, and other digital channels.
* Develop and implement strategies to enhance the credit union’s online reputation, engagement, and member loyalty.

Social Media Management

* Create, curate, and publish high-quality content that aligns with the credit union’s brand voice and business objectives.
* Engage with followers and respond to inquiries and comments to foster positive member relationships. Stay informed on social media trends, best practices, and emerging platforms to enhance the credit union’s digital presence.

Email Marketing and Digital Communications

* Develop and execute targeted email marketing campaigns that drive member engagement, product adoption, and retention.
* Create and manage segmented email lists, ensuring personalized and relevant communication based on member behavior and preferences.

Online Reputation and Member Experience

* Monitor and manage online reviews, ratings, and member feedback across digital platforms to maintain a positive brand reputation.
* Collaborate with internal teams to address member concerns and inquiries effectively and efficiently.
* Identify opportunities to enhance the member journey through optimized digital touchpoints and communications.

Content Development and Campaign Execution

* Collaborate with internal teams to develop and execute digital campaigns that promote products, services, and educational content.
* Leverage Paid Search/SEO best practices to improve search visibility and drive traffic to digital assets and manage outside vendors as needed.

Analytics and Reporting

* Track, measure, and report on the performance of digital marketing efforts, providing actionable insights to improve engagement and effectiveness.
* Use data analytics tools to assess the effectiveness of campaigns and identify areas for improvement.

Leadership Requirements

* Selects, hires, develops, motivates and coaches associates to achieve credit union and Department goals and objectives; includes cross training of associates.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Digital Media, or a related field or equivalent work experience and knowledge.

3+ years relevant experience in people management, digital marketing, in either Agency or Corporate environments, with a focus on managing social media, email marketing, and digital communications.

**Key Competencies:**

* Proficiency in using analytics tools (Google Analytics, social media insights, etc.) to track and measure digital performance.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing strategies, trends, and best practices.
* Experience with content management systems (CMS), email marketing platforms, and social media management tools.
* Excellent writing, editing, and communication skills with a keen eye for detail.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines while maintaining high-quality work.
* Experience with marketing automation and CRM platforms.
* Familiarity with SEO, SEM, and digital advertising strategies.

**What We Offer:**

You’ll be part of a dynamic team dedicated to reshaping how banking is perceived and experienced. Together, we’ll create meaningful connections with customers, foster growth, and transform the industry.

**Monetary Growth:**

* Final offers based on qualifications, experience, and internal equity. **The range for the Digital Marketing Manager role is $92,141.00 - $115,175.00 annually.**

* Annual performance merit increases.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Our law firm is positioned as Florida's Premier Residential Construction Law Firm for Homeowners. We help homeowners before, during, and after their custom home builds and major home renovation projects. This is a niche within the construction law niche that we are currently set to dominate through value-added services.

The firm is on track for aggressive growth, and we need a strategic and hands-on Marketing Manager to work with our Firm's CFO or Owner to lead our marketing efforts. The ideal candidate will have experience managing a multi-6-figure annual marketing budget, with expertise in technical SEO, vendor management, and digital campaigns within the legal industry. This role requires someone who understands the nuances of legal marketing, client acquisition, and community engagement to drive growth and build the firm's reputation.

**What We Offer:**

* Opportunity to lead marketing for a well-respected and growing Florida law firm.
* Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses tied to qualified lead generation and conversion goals.
* Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, vision/dental insurance, IRA, and PTO.
* Ongoing professional development opportunities and access to industry-leading tools and resources.

 **Compensation:**

$60,000 - $68,000 annually

 **Responsibilities:**

**Marketing Strategy & Execution**

* Develop and implement a comprehensive marketing strategy to increase leads, enhance brand presence, and grow client retention.
* Allocate and manage a $150,000 to $250,000 marketing budget across channels, including SEO, PPC, social media, and local advertising.
* Conduct market research to understand client demographics and competitive positioning, focusing on individual homeowners and HOAs.

**SEO & Website Optimization**

* Oversee technical SEO initiatives to improve website performance, search rankings, and conversion rates.
* Conduct regular website audits to ensure compliance with SEO best practices, focusing on high-value keywords for personal injury and criminal defense searches.
* Collaborate with web developers to enhance site architecture, speed, and mobile responsiveness.

**Lead Generation & Campaign Management**

* Plan, execute, and optimize paid advertising campaigns, including Google Ads and social media platforms, targeting audiences of homeowners with construction problems.
* Create engaging content for blogs, landing pages, and email campaigns to educate prospective clients and improve conversion rates.
* Monitor campaign performance using tools like Google Analytics and provide actionable insights for improvement.

**Vendor Management**

* Identify, vet, and manage relationships with external vendors, including SEO specialists, PPC consultants, and content creators.
* Ensure timely delivery of services and evaluate vendor performance based on key metrics.
* Negotiate contracts and manage vendor budgets to maximize ROI.
* Community Engagement & Reputation Management
* Build and manage the firm's online reputation through client testimonials, reviews, and community outreach programs.
* Coordinate sponsorships, community events, and partnerships that align with the firm’s brand and values.
* Oversee social media strategy to increase engagement and connect with local audiences.
* Develop referral marketing systems and channels for the Firm.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as cost per qualified lead, conversion rates, and ROI across all marketing channels.
* Provide regular reports to leadership, highlighting campaign performance, challenges, and recommendations for improvement.
* Use analytics to refine strategies and ensure alignment with business objectives.

 **Qualifications:**

**Required:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 5–7 years of experience in marketing, preferably within the legal industry.
* Proven success managing a $250,000 marketing budget with a focus on lead generation.
* Expertise in technical SEO, Google Ads, social media advertising, and content marketing.
* Strong experience in vendor management, including selecting and evaluating external partners.

**Preferred:**

* Familiarity with construction law firm marketing, including local SEO and client acquisition strategies.
* Experience with client relationship management (CRM) tools tailored to law firms (e.g., Clio).

**Key Skills:**

* Excellent project management and organizational skills, with the ability to handle multiple campaigns simultaneously.
* Analytical mindset with a focus on data-driven decision-making.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
* Knowledge of legal marketing compliance guidelines and ethics.

 **About Company**

Wyman Legal Solutions is a niche residential construction law firm representing homeowners, Associations, and contractors. We guide clients through high-stakes disputes that affect their homes, finances, and daily lives—projects that have gone sideways on scope, timing, payment, and quality. We resolve matters through sharp pre-suit positioning when possible, and we litigate strategically when it is necessary.

Our team consists of 5 attorneys, including a Managing Attorney, 4 paralegals, and a dedicated in-house sales and intake team.

Our firm is going places – quickly! For the past 5 years, we have been honored to make the Law Firm 500’s list of fastest-growing firms in the United States. We offer strong growth trajectories and benefits packages for our team members.

jobs.title: Senior SEO Manager (Remote)
jobs.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Today, we’re looking to add a new **Senior SEO Manager** to the team.

Silverback’s next Senior SEO Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to SEO & Organic Search. You will develop and manage a portfolio of 4-6 SEO accounts while building great client relationships and managing projects & deliverables. You’ll bring a scrappy & tenacious attitude to your work, diving headfirst into the “new frontier” of organic search by pushing the boundaries of AI search testing. You’ll flex best-in-class data analysis chops to break down performance metrics and directly impact the success of our clients’ businesses. Here’s what we expect from our Senior SEO Manager:

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategic Chops:** Responsible for driving and executing the strategy, innovation and performance of multiple client SEO strategies.
* **AI & LLM Expertise:** Hands-on experience with Generative AI and LLMs, including their influence on search behavior and the ability to implement optimized strategies for these engines. Ability to identify new opportunities
* **Analytical Skills:** Fluently leverage tools such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, and other SEO platforms, with a demonstrated ability to translate complex data into actionable insights.
* **Client-Facing:** Lead recurring status and reporting calls & serve as assigned clients’ primary point of contact with Silverback for all things SEO. Clearly communicate complex SEO strategy and execution details to clients in a digestible, jargon-free manner.
* **Client Management:** Act as a trusted advisor & consultant to clients — an extension of their marketing team — to build long-lasting client relationships.
* **Tactical Execution:** Translate channel strategy to time-bound, tactical roadmaps. Build and maintain structured content systems, including topic clusters, pillar pages, internal links, and supporting schema. Prioritize performance-based initiatives and drive authoritative content at scale.
* **Innovation:** Research emerging trends in search and AI technologies to refine strategies and implement innovative best practices.
* **Process/Delivery Improvements:** Identify opportunities to improve the SEO delivery and process to increase the value of the work or improve efficiency.
* **Data Analysis:** Review performance data to identify trends, measure the impact of initiatives and build actionable strategies.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Work with internal teammates across measurement, paid media, and creative to bring strategies to life.
* **Sales Support:** Work with the sales team to put together SEO strategy proposals and audits that align with their goals and objectives.

### **What You'll Need to Succeed**

* **Agency Background:** You’ve previously “done the work” at another performance marketing agency, and know what it takes to deliver results.
* **Years of Experience:** We’re seeking candidates with at LEAST 3 years of agency experience; 5+ years of overall relevant marketing/SEO experience is required.
* **Client-Facing Comfortability:** This role is not a good fit for someone who doesn’t want to talk directly to clients. You must be comfortable building rapport, establishing expertise / credibility, and serving as the face of the SEO engagement with your assigned clients.
* **Embrace Complexity:** As a Senior SEO Manager, this role will be exposed to more complex and challenging situations. You have a strong ability to navigate complexity and tackle challenges head on.
* **AI Search Testing & Optimization:** You have hands-on experience optimizing for AI search (not theoretical; actual tests). You don’t have all the answers — nobody does! — but you’re excited to test, experiment, and figure it out.
* **Business Acumen:** Being able to build & execute SEO strategies across multiple industries is crucial, but your ability to tie SEO wins to a measurable impact on the clients’ business, bottom line, etc is what will make you a superstar.
* **Content Experience:** You’re an expert at driving content strategy based on audience, keyword and competitor research. You have a strong ability to craft content briefs to provide to content teams for production.
* **Tools/Platforms:** You’re a pro with common SEO tools & platforms such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, SEMrush, AHRefs, and Screaming Frog.
* **Get Sh\*t Done” Mentality:** You’d rather take a big swing and miss than sit around twiddling your thumbs. You’re energized by & thrive in an environment where no two days are the same, and results are king.
* **Adaptability & Growth:** Feedback fuels you. You lean into change, sharpen your skills, and push yourself and your team to get better every day.
* **Project & Time Management:** You run a clean calendar and keep priorities straight. Competing demands don’t throw you.

### **Why Silverback?**

Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

* **Make an impact:** We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.
* **Get paid:** We hire the best and pay them generously.
* **Do cool sh\*t:** From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

### **Benefits & Perks**

* Unlimited PTO
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
* Virtual Team Events a

About EAB

At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.

For more information, visit our Careers page.

About Hybrid

Recently acquired by EAB, Hybrid is a globally recognized and award-winning agency that operates as a full-service marketing partner for the education sector, connecting universities with students worldwide. Powered by unrivaled insight, advanced technology, and AI-driven enrollment strategies, our integrated marketing solutions help education brands grow. We tackle the sector’s toughest challenges head-on and continuously strive for excellence, staying on the pulse of emerging trends. When you join our division of EAB, you become part of a tight-knit, ambitious, supportive, and rapidly growing team. You’ll work on big ideas with talented colleagues who respect your input, challenge your thinking and push you to do your best work. Visit our website to learn more about our story

**The Role in Brief:**

**Paid Media Executive, Hybrid**

Hybrid is seeking a motivated, analytical, and results-driven Paid Media Executive to join our growing Digital team. In this role, you'll execute and optimize paid media campaigns for higher education clients around the world, helping institutions connect with prospective students through innovative, data-driven digital marketing strategies.

As a Paid Media Executive, you'll manage campaigns across Google Ads, Meta, and other digital advertising platforms while partnering with Account Managers, Digital Strategists, and clients to deliver measurable performance. You'll analyze campaign data, uncover actionable insights, and continuously optimize campaigns to maximize results across multiple channels.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to grow their expertise in paid search, paid social, and emerging media platforms while working on global campaigns with significant budgets in a collaborative, fast-paced agency environment.

This hire may be based in Philadelphia, PA, Richmond, VA, or Washington, D.C.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

The Paid Media Executive is responsible for planning, launching, optimizing, and reporting on digital advertising campaigns that drive measurable results for Hybrid's higher education partners.

**Campaign Management**

* Plan, build, launch, and manage paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic platforms.

* Execute campaign optimizations to improve performance and maximize return on advertising spend.

* Monitor campaign pacing, budgets, and performance to ensure client objectives are achieved.

* Support international campaigns across emerging media platforms as business needs evolve.

**Performance Analysis & Optimization**

* Track campaign KPIs and analyze performance across multiple digital channels.

* Develop insightful campaign reports that clearly communicate results and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients.

* Identify performance trends, optimization opportunities, and emerging audience behaviors.

* Utilize data to continuously improve campaign effectiveness and overall client outcomes.

**Client Success & Collaboration**

* Build a strong understanding of each client's goals, enrollment objectives, and marketing strategy.

* Partner closely with Account Managers and Digital leadership to develop integrated media strategies.

* Collaborate with platform partners including Google and Meta to leverage best practices and new capabilities.

* Contribute ideas that improve campaign performance, innovation, and client experience.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain accurate campaign documentation, reporting, and time management.

* Ensure projects are completed on schedule while managing multiple client accounts simultaneously.

* Stay current on industry trends, platform updates, and emerging digital advertising technologies.

* Continue developing expertise across new advertising channels and international media platforms.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

* 1-3+ years of experience managing paid digital media campaigns, digital marketing, or performance marketing.

* Experience working with Google Ads and Meta Ads Manager.

* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret campaign data and identify actionable insights.

* Excellent organizational skills with strong attention to detail.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced agency environment.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or similar reporting tools.

* Self-motivated with a strong desire to continuously learn and improve.

**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Experience managing paid Search, Social, and Programmatic advertising campaigns.

* Familiarity with campaign tracking, attribution, and digital marketing analytics.

* Experience working with large advertising budgets across multiple clients.

* Passion for digital marketing, emerging advertising technologies, and performance optimization.

* Ability to think strategically while executing campaigns with precision.

**Join our team as a VP of Marketing and help virtualize biological experiments to accelerate discovery!**

**Location:** Remote - US East Coast

**Reports to:** Chief Business Officer

**About Turbine**

A lab without limits, built for biopharma.

Turbine’s Virtual Lab (vLab®) enables scientists to run Virtual Assays across millions of biological conditions far beyond traditional laboratory throughput. Instead of narrowing hypotheses to fit experimental constraints, scientists can explore the broader biological search space computationally before deciding what to validate in the wet lab. Turbine doesn’t replace the wet lab. It makes every experiment count. Through an integrated lab-in-the-loop workflow, virtual findings become testable hypotheses, with validation results feeding back to strengthen subsequent predictions within the workflow.

In deployed programs, Turbine has reduced decision timelines from 12-18 months to approximately two months while cutting wet-lab experiments by more than 50%.

Working with scientists at leading biopharma like MSD (Merck & Co.), AstraZeneca and Bayer, Turbine’s virtual assays have rationalized experiments across more than 30 discovery programs.

Backed by leading tech and industry investors like Accel, MSD Global Health Innovation Fund, Interactive Venture Partners and Beiersdorf, Turbine is turning biology into an engineering discipline.

**About the Role**

Turbine is seeking a **strategic VP of Marketing to build the company's reputation and market position as a leader in BioAI and virtual biology**, translating our scientific and commercial differentiation into a clear corporate narrative, strong executive presence, and increased engagement with leading biopharma organizations.

A central mandate will be to elevate the external profiles of Turbine's founders and leadership team and establish them as credible, distinctive voices in BioAI and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.

The VP of Marketing will provide the strategic marketing leadership required as Turbine scales commercially and expands its technology across modalities and therapeutic areas. They will act as a strategic advisor to the CEO, founders, CBO, and wider leadership team on positioning, external communications, executive visibility, and market engagement.

The VP will lead Turbine's marketing function, setting strategy and direction across corporate and product marketing while developing a high-performing team focused on product marketing, scientific content, conferences, and sales enablement.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Corporate Strategy, Positioning & Brand**

* Own and continuously sharpen Turbine's corporate positioning and market narrative.
* Define Turbine's overarching corporate narrative and category positioning.
* Establish clear, differentiated messaging around virtual biology, Virtual Cells, Virtual Assays, and Virtual Lab.
* Translate sophisticated science and technology into compelling and accessible market narratives.
* Clearly differentiate Turbine within the AI drug discovery, virtual cell, and broader TechBio landscape.
* Ensure consistency across corporate, product, scientific, and commercial communications.
* Build and maintain a differentiated corporate brand and consistent visual and verbal identity as the company and product portfolio expand.
* Monitor market, customer, and competitive developments and translate these insights into positioning and go-to-market strategy.

**Founder & Executive Thought Leadership**

* Build a systematic thought-leadership platform around Turbine's founders and leadership team.
* Develop distinct thought-leadership territories for priority executives.
* Identify and secure relevant speaking, media, podcast, panel, and authorship opportunities.
* Develop executive narratives, talking points, and opinion pieces.
* Prepare executives for high-profile external engagements.
* Build relationships with conference organizers, industry influencers, and relevant ecosystem leaders.
* Position Turbine executives as credible and sought-after voices on AI, biology, and the future of pharmaceutical R&D.
* Work with external agencies and internal teams to deliver consistent and sustained executive visibility.

**PR, Communications & BioAI Ecosystem**

* Own Turbine's global PR and external communications strategy.
* Build direct relationships with influential biopharma, biotech, technology, and AI journalists and editors.
* Lead and manage external PR and communications partners.
* Develop proactive media narratives beyond company announcements and press releases.
* Build communications programs around scientific results, partnerships, funding, product developments, and customer milestones.
* Maximize the impact of corporate announcements through targeted media engagement and follow-on coverage.
* Generate proactive earned-media opportunities around relevant industry developments and conversations.
* Manage corporate announcements and issues communications.
* Increase high-quality earned media coverage and Turbine's share of voice in BioAI and virtual biology.

**Commercial Marketing & Account Engagement**

* Partner closely with Business Development and Product Marketing to translate Turbine's positioning into commercial impact.
* Develop marketing strategies for priority biopharma accounts, therapeutic areas, and use cases.
* Use account-based marketing and targeted campaigns to increase engagement within strategic accounts.
* Coordinate executive, conference, content, and digital activity around priority accounts.
* Develop messaging and campaigns around customer needs and commercial priorities.
* Drive measurable marketing contribution to qualified pipeline and strategic-account engagement.
* Use customer, market, and competitive insights to inform marketing and commercial strategy.

**Position Summary**

ARK Homes For Rent is a growing Build-to-Rent company, and we need a Marketing Strategist, Digital & Paid Media to run the paid campaigns that fill our communities. You will own paid search, paid social, display, and ILS spend across ARK's growing portfolio of new and established Build-to-Rent communities, and you will be measured on what that spend produces: qualified leads, tours, and signed leases.

Lease-up is where this role matters most. When a new community opens, your campaigns set the pace for how quickly it fills. You will work with the Marketing Director, regional managers, and on-site teams to build channel plans around each community's occupancy goals, then adjust them week to week as results come in. The right person is as comfortable in the ad platforms as in a spreadsheet, asks why a number moved, and will push back when the data does not support the plan.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Channel Planning for Each Community**

* Build a paid media plan for every community in the portfolio, sized to its stage: pre-leasing, lease-up, or stabilized.
* Decide where budget goes across Google, Meta, display, ILS listings, and newer channels based on each market and which sources are producing leases.
* Write targeting and messaging for each campaign that speaks to the renters each community is built for.
* Plan ahead for new community openings so campaigns are live before the first homes deliver.

**Running the Campaigns**

* Build, launch, and manage campaigns day to day, including budgets, targeting, tracking, and creative.
* Confirm tracking is in place before launch so every lead can be traced back to its source.

* Partner with website and technology vendors to make sure sites are built and launched correctly, stay functional, and support lead generation and leasing goals.
* Develop and optimize prospect nurture, re-engagement, prelease, and lifecycle campaigns across email and marketing automation platforms, measuring their impact on tours, applications, and leases.

**Measurement & Reporting**

* Report on cost per lead, cost per lease, lead-to-tour and tour-to-lease conversion, and spend by channel and community.
* Follow leads past the click by working with leasing teams to see which sources turn into residents.
* Flag communities falling behind occupancy pace early and bring a recovery plan to the Marketing Director.

* Develop and run ongoing tests across creative, messaging, audiences, landing experiences, offers, and channel mix, documenting what you learn so it can be applied across the portfolio.

**Working With Operations & Leadership**

* Partner with community managers and leasing teams so campaigns support what is happening on site, such as specials, open houses, and model availability.
* Share results and recommendations in plain terms with operations leadership.
* Build presentations for senior leadership, from marketing performance updates to quarterly business reviews and investor decks, turning marketing, leasing, and portfolio data into clear, polished slides.
* Contribute channel-level data to forecasting and budget planning.
* Establish and document standards for campaign setup, naming conventions, tracking, reporting, testing, and digital best practices so performance can be compared and successful strategies repeated across communities.

**Analytical Skills**

* Comfortable pulling data from multiple platforms and turning it into a decision.

* Asks why a result moved and keeps digging until there is an answer.

jobs.description:
About EAB

At EAB, our mission is to make education smarter and our communities stronger. We work with more than 2,800 institutions to drive transformative change through data-driven insights and best-in-class capabilities. From kindergarten to college to career, EAB partners with leaders and practitioners to accelerate progress and drive results across enrollment, student success, institutional strategy, data analytics, and advancement. We work with each partner differently, tailoring our portfolio of research, technology, and marketing and enrollment solutions to meet the unique needs of every leadership team, as well as the students and employees they serve.

At EAB, we serve not only our partner institutions but each other—that's why we are always working to make sure our employees love their jobs and are invested in their communities. See how we've been recognized for this dedication to our employees by checking out our recent awards.

For more information, visit our Careers page.

About Hybrid

Recently acquired by EAB, Hybrid is a globally recognized and award-winning agency that operates as a full-service marketing partner for the education sector, connecting universities with students worldwide. Powered by unrivaled insight, advanced technology, and AI-driven enrollment strategies, our integrated marketing solutions help education brands grow. We tackle the sector’s toughest challenges head-on and continuously strive for excellence, staying on the pulse of emerging trends. When you join our division of EAB, you become part of a tight-knit, ambitious, supportive, and rapidly growing team. You’ll work on big ideas with talented colleagues who respect your input, challenge your thinking and push you to do your best work. Visit our website to learn more about our story

**The Role in Brief:**

**Paid Media Manager, Hybrid**

Hybrid is seeking an experienced, strategic, and results-driven Paid Media Manager to join our growing Digital team. This role is ideal for a paid media professional who enjoys balancing hands-on campaign execution with leadership, mentoring, and strategic planning.

As a Paid Media Manager, you will oversee high-performing paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic channels while partnering with Account Directors, Digital leadership, and clients to develop innovative marketing strategies that drive enrollment and brand growth for higher education institutions worldwide.

In addition to managing complex digital campaigns, you'll play a key role in developing team capabilities, improving operational processes, and helping shape the continued growth of Hybrid's Paid Media function. This is an outstanding opportunity for someone looking to expand their leadership experience while remaining deeply involved in digital strategy and campaign performance.

This hire may be based in Philadelphia, PA, Richmond, VA, or Washington, D.C.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

The Paid Media Manager is responsible for leading the planning, execution, optimization, and strategic direction of paid media campaigns while supporting the growth and development of Hybrid's Digital team.

**Campaign Strategy & Execution**

* Lead the planning, launch, optimization, and reporting of paid media campaigns across Search, Social, and Programmatic channels.

* Develop sophisticated campaign strategies, audience targeting, bidding approaches, and measurement frameworks.

* Oversee campaign pacing, budget allocation, and performance to ensure client goals are achieved.

* Manage complex campaign builds while maintaining exceptional quality and attention to detail.

**Client Strategy & Performance**

* Serve as a trusted digital marketing advisor to clients by translating campaign performance into strategic recommendations.

* Present campaign insights, reporting, and optimization strategies during client meetings.

* Develop detailed performance analyses, competitor research, and actionable recommendations.

* Partner with Account Directors to support integrated media planning and long-term client success.

**Team Leadership & Development**

* Mentor, coach, and support Paid Media Executives and junior team members.

* Share best practices, technical expertise, and platform knowledge across the Digital team.

* Identify opportunities to improve team workflows, campaign processes, and operational efficiency.

* Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment focused on continuous learning and innovation.

**Digital Innovation & Operational Excellence**

* Stay current on emerging advertising platforms, industry trends, and evolving best practices.

* Leverage Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok, Reddit, YouTube, Snapchat, and other advertising platforms to deliver innovative client solutions.

* Manage multiple client campaigns and competing priorities while ensuring timely execution.

* Support the continued growth and evolution of Hybrid's Paid Media capabilities.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred or equivalent professional experience.

* 4-6+ years of experience managing paid digital media campaigns in an agency or similar client-facing environment.

* Demonstrated experience managing campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and other major paid media platforms.

* Strong knowledge of Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, campaign tracking, and performance reporting.

* Experience presenting campaign strategy and results to clients and senior stakeholders.

* Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

* Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

**Ideal Qualifications:**

* Experience leading or mentoring digital marketing team members.

* Experience managing six-figure digital advertising budgets across multiple client accounts.

* Deep understanding of paid Search, Paid Social, Programmatic, audience targeting, and attribution.

However, because close collaboration with dealership operations is key to our strategy, **candidates must reside within a reasonable driving distance of our New England locations in Massachusetts, Vermont and New Hampshire for onsite meetings 1–2 times per month or as needed.**

annually, depending on experience.

**E-commerce and digital marketing**

* Improve how customers discover, evaluate, and purchase products through our online store.

* Manage paid advertising directly or oversee outside support, depending on the campaign and available resources.

**Content and brand coordination**

**Performance and accountability**

* Establish baseline performance and agreed goals with leadership.
* Monitor online sales, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, campaign spending, and relevant store-level indicators.

SocialSoule is a boutique social media and content marketing agency working with hospitality, lifestyle, wellness, and other experience-driven brands. We're looking for a creative, detail-oriented Social Media Content Editor to join our growing team.

We're not looking for someone who specializes in elaborate motion graphics or over-the-top transitions. We're looking for someone who knows how to make great footage even better.

Someone who understands pacing, storytelling, clean cuts, music selection, and the little details that make short-form content feel intentional, polished, and engaging.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone who can take a creative direction, understand the vision, and confidently execute it.

What You'll Do

* Edit short-form videos for Instagram Reels, TikTok, and other social platforms.
* Turn raw footage into polished, engaging, ready-to-publish content.
* Select strong clips, create seamless cuts, and maintain engaging pacing.
* Incorporate trending audio, music, text overlays, and subtle transitions when appropriate.

* Collaborate with our creative and marketing team to bring content concepts to life.
* Make thoughtful creative decisions without requiring extensive direction.
* Organize editing projects and deliver content within agreed deadlines.
* Apply feedback efficiently while maintaining a consistent standard of quality.

* Proven experience editing short-form social media content.
* Strong proficiency in CapCut, which is our team's primary editing platform.
* A natural understanding of pacing, storytelling, composition, and visual flow.
* A strong eye for elevated, clean, aesthetically appealing content.
* Understanding of Instagram Reels, TikTok, and current social media editing styles.
* Ability to adapt editing styles across different brands and industries.
* Someone who takes initiative, pays attention to detail, and can work independently.
* Strong communication and reliable turnaround times.

The Kind of Editor We'd Love to Work With

You're the person who can watch raw footage and immediately recognize the strongest moments.

You know when to cut, when to let a shot breathe, and how to build a video that feels cohesive without relying on flashy effects.

You don't need a detailed tutorial to understand a reference video, and you're comfortable making creative decisions that improve the final product.

Above all, you understand that good editing isn't about doing the most. It's about making every second count.

* A portfolio featuring short-form social media videos you've personally edited.

**We're especially interested in seeing clean, thoughtfully edited content that demonstrates strong pacing, storytelling, and attention to detail.**
